slides.title: Your hotel site hides the ==price==
slides.sub: 3 jobs a hotel website has. Most only do one.

slides.title: A guest from Instagram decides ==on the first screen.==
slides.sub: If they have to call for the rate, they keep scrolling.

slides.title: Show the ==rate==
slides.body: Room, dates, price per night. On the first screen, not behind "call us".

slides.title: Give them **trust**
slides.body: Real room photos, your location on a map, the reviews you already have, a clear cancellation policy.

slides.title: Give them ==one button==
slides.body: Book now, or WhatsApp us. One tap on a phone, no long form.

slides.title: Your website is the net. ==Traffic is the water.==
slides.body: Instagram, Google and ads bring the guests. The website turns them into bookings. You need both.

items.text: Guests coming in from Google, Instagram or ads

slides.title: Comment ==HOTEL==
slides.body: We'll send a free cost and timeline estimate for your hotel website.

slides.title: Same ERP. ==A year apart.==
slides.sub: One plant types every supplier invoice. The other reviews only what AI flags.

slides.title: 14 fields before KYC? ==Ask 3.==
slides.sub: Name, phone, PAN. Show the offer. Then ask for documents.

slides.title: Same ad. Two websites. ==One shows the rate.==
slides.sub: A guest who tapped an ad shouldn't have to call for the price.

slides.title: Comment ==KYC==
slides.body: Free 20-minute call on your sign-up flow.

slides.title: Stop typing ==supplier invoices==
slides.sub: AI reads the PDF. Your team checks only what it flags.

slides.title: "AI will get our ==invoices== wrong."
slides.sub: Fair worry. Here's the setup that handles it.

slides.title: Someone types every supplier invoice ==by hand.==
slides.sub: Same 5 fields: GST number, item, quantity, rate, total.

slides.title: AI ==reads== the PDF
slides.body: Supplier invoices from Gmail or WhatsApp, read field by field.

slides.title: It fills a **draft** entry
slides.body: In Tally or your ERP, as a draft. Nothing posts on its own.

slides.title: Your team checks ==the flags==
slides.body: Anything the model isn't sure about goes to a person: a changed rate, a short quantity, a duplicate bill.

items.text: Draft entry in Tally or ERP

slides.body: Free 20-minute call to see if your invoices are a good fit.

slides.title: Guests shouldn't ==call for the price==
slides.sub: Room, rate, Book button. On the first screen.
